ops.title: RESOLVED 2026-07-12: the pre-journal cc-notes incumbent was retired ONE TIME by the pre-cutover CLI's own graceful `mount --shutdown` (downloaded v0.26.0 binary) — no Converge shim ever shipped; fusekit v1.0.0 deleted Converge (F2 landed). Lesson stands:

ops.body:
**RESOLVED (2026-07-12, primary-Mac migration):** the displacement happened exactly once, operator-driven, with no code shim: cc-notes had already been brew-upgraded to v0.27.0, so the v0.26.0 release binary was downloaded from GitHub and its `mount --shutdown` retired the private holder gracefully (process, socket, and mount all confirmed gone) — the exact recipe v0.27.0's `refuseIncumbentHolder` prints. The new CLI then mounted three repos on the shared v1.0.0 holder. Converge was deleted outright in fusekit v1.0.0 (F2 landed without a transition shim). yasyf-home has no incumbent (fresh install). The durable lesson below stands.

Discovered 2026-07-10 in the cc-notes-adopt review (fable synth re-scoped a codex finding codex itself understated).

**The gap.** cc-notes-adopt deletes `RemoteHost.Converge` (the old version-skew displace-and-replace) and relies on the fusekit v0.38.x self-owning holder (journal + exe-hash self-retire) instead. But the real fleet incumbent on every existing machine is the **released v0.23.0 cc-notes holder = fusekit v0.14.1: no journal, no retire loop**, live on the SAME private socket (`~/.cc-notes/mounts.sock`). The adopt change has nothing to displace it: `refreshHolderBinary` swaps stable-copy bytes the old holder never polls, `ensureRunning` adopts its live socket, and NO path sends OpShutdown (— `--shutdown` is per-owner Reclaim only; there is no user command that stops a holder). So on first upgrade the whole feature (journal, self-retire, probe/force policies) is **inert until reboot/pkill**, and new mounts land UNjournaled on the old holder (it silently accepts OpMount and drops the new policy fields).

**Why:** self-retire is a bootstrap-from-scratch mechanism; it can't retire a predecessor that doesn't know how to self-retire. Migrating OFF Converge needs Converge (or an OpShutdown displace) ONE LAST TIME for the pre-journal generation.

**How to apply:**
- The fix is a ONE-TIME, version-gated displacement of the pre-journal incumbent: when serveDetached/health-preflight detects a live holder whose wire version predates the self-owning discipline (OpHealth exists back to v0.14.1), do a single graceful replace (reuse the still-existing `RemoteHost.Converge`, or per-owner Reclaim→OpShutdown→respawn-from-fresh-stable-copy), gated STRICTLY to the pre-journal generation so the steady-state "no OpShutdown, self-retire only" discipline (and its pinned tests) is untouched for v0.38-era holders. Verify what ops a v0.14.1 holder actually understands (OpReclaim is a newer N1 op — a v0.14.1 incumbent may only grok OpShutdown).
- **This GATES fusekit F2** (delete Converge/public Retire → v0.39.0): Converge cannot be deleted from fusekit until the fleet's pre-journal holders are gone, because the transition shim reuses it. F2 stays deferred until cc-notes' brew-upgrade displacement is proven on a real upgrade. Reinforces [[claude-pool-project]]'s F2-deferred stance and the "ship capability ahead of consumer" pattern.
- cc-notes-adopt core work (delete cask mode = the wrong-bytes fix, self-owning wiring, IdlePolicyProbe/CarcassPolicyForce, passive skew via v0.38.4 RefreshStableExe) is otherwise reviewed GREEN and banked in workspace `/Users/yasyf/Code/cc-notes-n1` (not yet tagged); this displacement is the one remaining mustFix before a cc-notes release.
